notes: Shelf "Luxury land & estates": 8 kinds as planned. Old k16 Vineyard folded into "Vineyard & wine estate" (old landsale.co.uk listing source replaced by the Wikipedia Vineyard article); old k26 Airstrip folded into "Airpark home & private airstrip" (old communityimpact listing source replaced by the Wikipedia Airpark article). Every kind and archetype is sourced to a Wikipedia article fetched this session (wiki tool was erroring with a lock-file fault, so pages were retrieved via web_search→web_fetch; Wikidata search confirmed Q2984210 "privately owned island"). Archetypes are named exemplars that define the type (Necker, Skorpios, Lānaʻi; Balmoral; Claiborne Farm; Lafite and Tenuta San Guido; King Ranch and Anna Creek; Spruce Creek) with empty "mk" since these are maker-free patterns; "v" left empty because no versions apply to land. Country estate and Waterfront property carry no archetypes: the Estate (land) page names many houses but none defines the type, and waterfront is defined by rights (riparian/littoral) rather than exemplars — the Littoral rights page was also retrieved and informs the "t" list. No brands or traditions: no maker brands own these property kinds, and artisan traditions are not relevant to land; hacienda/estancia house forms are left to the Houses department (Hacienda & estancia) per the outline, with a cross-link noted in Ranch & station types. Scottish Land Commission / USDA / FEI reference pages were not fetched (Wikipedia definitions sufficed); no listings were used.
